sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for facility 10191085 (38 sites: type, equipment, lengths)

values.note: $14 a night per single site, first-come and reserved seasons alike. The fee covers one camping unit; on large sites a second unit is allowed but pays the full nightly fee by envelope at the entrance kiosk.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/chippewa/recreation/north-star-campground ('Overnight Use: Single Site: $14 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10191085/rates (2026 First-come, First-served Season and Peak Season, $14) + rec.gov notice ('Fee includes one camping unit per site... on large sites double occupancy is permitted. The second occupant must pay the full nightly amount'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: New for 2026: sites 22-38 reservable on recreation.gov from July 3 to September 6; sites 1-21 stay first-come, first-served, and any site without a reservation is first-come. Reservations are posted 4 days ahead (no booking within 4 days).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10191085 (notice '!! NEW FOR 2026 !! Sites 22-38 will be reservable through recreation.gov from 7/3/2026 to the evening of 9/6/26. Sites 1-21 will remain first-come first-served. When there is no reservation for a site, the site is considered first-come first-served. Reservations will be posted 4 days in advance'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, reservationCutOff 4) + USFS page (same split), read 2026-11-11

values.note: 2026: May 23 to November 24 (USFS); recreation.gov's first-come season starts May 22.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/chippewa/recreation/north-star-campground ('Seasons of Use 5/23/26 - 11/24/26') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10191085/rates (First-come, First-served Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-07-02, Peak 2026-07-03 to 2026-09-06, First-come 2026-09-07 to 2026-11-24), read 2026-11-11

values.note: All 38 sites are standard nonelectric and accept RVs, trailers and fifth wheels; USFS lists no size restriction. Posted lengths, where given (26 sites), run 48-100 ft.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite search, facility 10191085 (38 STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites, every one listing RV/Trailer/Fifth Wheel; max lengths 48-100 ft on 26 sites, none on 12) + USFS page ('No. of Sites 38', 'Size Restrictions No'), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/chippewa/recreation/north-star-campground ('Vault toilets are available at the Campground') + rec.gov amenities ('Vault Toilets'), read 2026-11-11

note: Chippewa National Forest campground in pine woods on North Star Lake, within easy walking distance of a sandy swimming beach; sheltered bays for fishing and quiet paddling. Black bears are active in the campground: food and coolers must be kept in hard-sided campers or vehicles. --Claude
summary: rec.gov record/rates/catalog and the USFS page read: $14 (2026), 38 nonelectric sites all RV-capable (lengths 48-100 ft where posted, no FS size limit), sites 22-38 reservable July 3-Sept 6 with a 4-day cutoff and the rest FCFS, 14-night limit, season May 23-Nov 24 2026, vault toilets. Drinking water conflicts between the two pages (flag).
flags: DRINKING WATER conflict: USFS page says 'Potable water is not available at this site'; recreation.gov amenities list 'Drinking Water' and 'Drinking Water (hand pump)'. potable_water left unset; reviewer's call (rec.gov is usually trusted, but an amenity checklist is weaker than the FS statement).

Not waterfront kept: the loops lie under continuous pine canopy between Highway 38 and North Star Lake; a few spurs on the west loop look to be within ~40-50 m of the shore (about 47.5575,-93.6550) but through trees, and imagery can only veto here. No rec.gov site attribute gives proximity to water.
